messages:
mara: Quick follow-up to the sampling/cohorting RFC — thinking about moving cohorting decisions earlier in the pipeline (gateway) vs the current enrichment stage. Want to capture tradeoffs for cost attribution and trace continuity. Thoughts?

josh: +1 to doing cohorting at the gateway to keep ingest cardinality down. downside: gateway doesn't always have billing_key/user context so attribution might be fuzzy.

anika: Key point: trace IDs must persist even when sampled, otherwise SLO/regression debugging is painful. What about a two-stage decision: gateway emits a lightweight hint and enrichment finalizes the cohort?

kevin: For cost attribution we require billing_key on the envelope root. If gateway makes early decisions, we can attach a hashed hint instead of raw key to avoid PII. e.g. `billing_hint` header with sha256.

mara: Example header we could use:
```
X-RW-Billing-Hint: sha256:abcd1234...
```
Gateway uses this for cohort bucketing; enrichment replaces with canonical billing_key when available.

observability-bot: incident-note: previousdeploy 2026-11-02 — sampled traces missing billing_key -> $1.2k misattributed GPU cost in nightly reports.

luis: For metrics: add `ingest.requests.by_cohort` counter with tag `sample_decision:gateway|enrichment|pass`. Also produce `traces.sampled_by` gauge for debugging.

anika: Edge: retries/duplicates could flip cohort. Make cohort_decision idempotent: include `cohort_decision_ts` and `cohort_version` fields so enrichment can reconcile.

josh: Ops/rollout: plan canary at 20% traffic then 100%. Fallback: if gateway cannot compute hint, enrichment must be able to compute cohort deterministically.

mara: +1. Also add a short backfill migration to retroactively tag 7 days of ingested traces in the lake for evaluation before full rollout.

kevin: Perf note: gateway hashing + mod for cohorting is cheap (<0.5ms per request) if we keep it simple. I'll prototype a fast C++/Rust embedding this week.

anika: TODOs I/O: 1) update ingest contract doc, 2) new header schema + examples, 3) dashboards & alerting for cohort drift, 4) canary runbook. I'll open the RFC follow-up PR and link here.

mara: Thanks — pinging @kevin @josh to pair on the PR. :thumbsup:

josh: quick Q — should we version the cohort algorithm? I'd prefer `cohort_v1` in header so queries can filter easily.

anika: yes, add `cohort_version:v1` to the envelope; enrichment can bump to v2 later and we can run A/B.

mara: Great. We'll sync in the design doc. Closing this thread once PR is up.
